intramolecular-force.def: A force between the atoms inside one particle: covalent, ionic or metallic bonding.

potential-energy-curve.def: A graph of the potential energy of two atoms against the distance between their nuclei; its minimum gives the bond length and the bond energy.

bond-length.def: The distance between the nuclei of two bonded atoms, at the minimum of their potential energy curve.

bond-energy.def: The energy needed to break one mole of a bond, equal to the depth of the potential energy minimum below zero.

bond-multiplicity.def: The number of electron pairs shared between two atoms: one in a single bond, two in a double bond, three in a triple bond.
